São 140 mil imagens em alta resolução, áudios e mais de 40 horas de vídeos também em alta resolução. Entre os ministros com acesso a todo esse material estão Cristiano Zanin e Gilmar Mendes. item.description: Nigeria’s food and drug regulator on Saturday said alcoholic concoctions tainted with methanol killed 48 people and sickened 182 in recent weeks. Methanol is highly toxic and causes death by organ failure as well as blindness. The country’s National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) said five...
